airzone_ui.title: Airzone
airzone_ui.subtitle: Temperature and comfort in every zone, at a glance.
airzone_ui.workshop_link: Find your temperatures and setpoints in the Airzone view.
airzone_ui.read_only_help: No command is sent to equipment. Names, rooms and cards can be managed in Moli.
airzone_ui.empty: No visible native Airzone zones yet.
airzone_ui.empty_help: Devices from Home Assistant remain in Rooms and Workshop. Zones from the Airzone driver appear here when discovered.
airzone_ui.not_found: This zone is no longer available in this view.
airzone_ui.activity_help: An enabled zone does not necessarily mean the heating is running. These are the demands reported by the system.
airzone_ui.offline_help: This zone is not responding. Displayed readings are retained and may not reflect its current state.
airzone_ui.connection_lost: Connection to Moli interrupted. Readings are no longer updating.
airzone_ui.shared_help: These settings affect several zones. They are shown separately from this room’s own setpoints.
airzone_ui.installation_help: Connectivity, systems and information available from your gateways.
airzone_ui.optional_help: Missing information does not prevent zone readings. Availability depends on the equipment and the local API.
airzone_ui.schedules_help: Airzone Cloud schedules are not exposed by this local API. They are not imported into this view.
airzone_ui.manage_help: Names and visibility in Moli, without changing your Airzone equipment.
airzone_ui.alerts_help: Reported issues and connections that need checking.
airzone_ui.add_help: Find a hidden device, a new zone or another gateway.
airzone_ui.observation_help: This view shows equipment status. Control permission is configured separately for each gateway in Installation.
airzone_ui.control_view_help: Controls follow each gateway’s capabilities and permissions.
